overview.description: The Columbia U.S. High Yield ETF (NJNK) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high yield fixed income. The fund is an actively managed fund that invests in high-yield US corporate bonds of any maturity. The funds objective is to provide a high level of current income. NJNK was launched on Sep 5, 2024 and is issued by Columbia Threadneedle.
